classification_recommendation.reasoning: In code ENTER 00 is a navigation to a distinct route (/enter) with its own locked environment plate (ENTER_00_WAITING_ROOM), its own location label, and a reciprocal EXIT 00 that returns to ORIGIN. It is not an overlay (no modal/dialog, has a URL, has a status strip) and not global navigation (it does not persist across pages — it is one hop from Origin and offers destinations). It is the threshold between ORIGIN (outside) and the interior. Treat the trigger (header toggle, ENTER SITE 00 link, and ideally swipe-up) as a SHELL_INTERACTION whose single target is this portal; the directory content inside it is the WAITING ROOM. FAST TRAVEL is the actual GLOBAL_OVERLAY. Recommendation is contingent on founder decision U2 (merge LOCATIONS into WAITING ROOM).

back_behavior.item: FastTravelPanel pushes an overlay history entry on open and calls window.history.back() on close/Esc/backdrop; popstate closes panel (hardware/browser back closes overlay).

On destination click, navigateAndClose does history.replaceState(null,'') on the overlay entry before the Link pushes the new route. This replaces the overlay entry (same URL) with a null state, wiping React Router's {usr,key,idx}; browser back then lands on a duplicate of the previous page (same URL) and a second back is needed to go further. Probable context-loss/duplicate-entry bug (CONFIRM_LIVE).
EXIT 00 (both public variants) is a forward push to /origin, not replace/back; history accumulates loops Origin->Locations->Origin.
Desktop LOCATIONS uses <Navigate replace> so back skips it (good), but the intended page is never shown.

context_loss.issue: Preview device mode (Site00Provider useReducer) is decided once at first mount; /enter forces 'desktop' on hard load. Hard-loading /enter on a phone gives a scaled 1440 artboard; EXIT 00 to /origin likely keeps 'desktop' state (sibling routes share the same Site00Layout element type, so the provider is probably not remounted) -> phone Origin renders desktop artboard without swipe. Conversely mobile Origin -> /enter client-side renders native mobile /enter.
Swipe transition timer not cancelled on unmount — later navigate to /origin/locations can override a navigation the user made during the 720ms window.
FastTravel replaceState(null,'') wipes router state of the overlay entry; duplicate back entry.
LOCATIONS page has no FAST TRAVEL (header swapped to EXIT 00; panel not mounted), so the only exits are EXIT 00, cards and bottom nav.
Auth-lock state on ENTER/LOCATIONS rows uses localStorage flag not session; a stale flag shows unlocked rows that then hit Site00AccountRouteGuard.
